requirements.basis: Continuously read the complete task and report. The selection is manageable, small-molecule centered and explicitly non-census, retaining DSP-1181, EXS21546 and REC-994 discontinuations alongside positive and preclinical cases. Identity/alias, indication, formulation, mechanism, sponsor/partner and dated progress are resolved in the register and histories; registration, actual study start, dosing, readout, planned development and regulatory decisions remain distinct. Sections 3–5 trace identifiable AI roles through assay and medicinal-chemistry feedback, preclinical work and clinical outcomes; existing compounds and repurposing are not presented as de novo AI molecules. Clinical interpretations preserve design, comparator, sample/analysis denominators, endpoints, missingness and limitations, including rentosertib analyses, REC-4881 evaluability, mixed baricitinib endpoints and SYCAMORE administrative closure versus development stop. Section 6 distinguishes retrospective metrics, prospective experimental yield and clinical benefit, and handles speed clocks, conventional comparators and selected aggregate cohorts. Section 7 describes laboratory/development roles, data/platform/program rights, decision/handoff structures, and separates upfront, milestone ceilings, triggered payments, royalties and revenue. Recommendations are conditional on the next scientific uncertainty. The evidence appendix records pre-cutoff registry versions, conflicts and inaccessible details without inventing missing facts. English complete report and locatable citations satisfy the specified deliverables.
requirements.location: Entire frozen report lines 1–288: dated identity register, all seven longitudinal program histories, every clinical/result table, stage comparison, partnerships, decision implications and evidence appendix.
